```{=html}
<style>
.w124-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w124-dd .w124-rows { margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w124-dd .w124-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.w124-dd .w124-row.w124-right { border-color: #2e7d32; border-width: 2px; }
.w124-dd .w124-row.w124-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; border-width: 2px; }
.w124-dd .w124-text { flex: 1; }
.w124-dd .w124-tf { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.w124-dd .w124-tf button {
  padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.w124-dd .w124-tf button.w124-sel { background: #d81e2e; border-color: #d81e2e; color: #fff; }
.w124-dd .w124-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w124-dd .w124-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w124-dd .w124-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w124-dd .w124-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w124-dd .w124-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w124-dd .w124-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w124-dd iw" id="w124-dd">
  <div class="w124-rows"></div>
  <div class="w124-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w124-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w124-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w124-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w124-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w124-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w124-dd');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w124-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w124-msg');
  const STATEMENTS = [
    { answer: true,  text: 'The recovery time objective (RTO) states how quickly a service must be back.' },
    { answer: true,  text: 'The recovery point objective (RPO) states how much recent data the organisation can afford to lose.' },
    { answer: false, text: 'How fast a restore must be is set by the RPO.' },
    { answer: false, text: 'BCM protects the technical service, while the resilience of Session 11 protects the business function it supports.' },
    { answer: true,  text: 'Continuity planning includes training staff to fall back to a spare system, or to paper, while the main system is down.' },
    { answer: false, text: 'A cloud incident is a matter for the technical responders alone; management, legal and compliance have no part to play.' }
  ];
  const rows = [];

  function clearMarks() {
    rows.forEach(r => r.el.classList.remove('w124-right', 'w124-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w124-msg iw-msg';
  }
  STATEMENTS.forEach(st => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w124-row';
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'w124-text';
    span.textContent = st.text;
    const tf = document.createElement('span');
    tf.className = 'w124-tf';
    const state = { el: row, answer: st.answer, sel: null, btns: {} };
    [['True', true], ['False', false]].forEach(([label, val]) => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.textContent = label;
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.sel = (state.sel === val) ? null : val;
        state.btns[true].classList.toggle('w124-sel', state.sel === true);
        state.btns[false].classList.toggle('w124-sel', state.sel === false);
        clearMarks();
      });
      state.btns[val] = b;
      tf.appendChild(b);
    });
    row.appendChild(span); row.appendChild(tf);
    rowsBox.appendChild(row);
    rows.push(state);
  });

  root.querySelector('.w124-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, open = 0;
    rows.forEach(r => {
      r.el.classList.remove('w124-right', 'w124-wrong');
      if (r.sel === null) { open++; return; }
      if (r.sel === r.answer) { r.el.classList.add('w124-right'); right++; }
      else { r.el.classList.add('w124-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === rows.length) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — RTO is about time, RPO about data, and continuity is everybody’s business.';
      msg.className = 'w124-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else if (open > 0 && wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + open + ' statement(s) still unanswered.';
      msg.className = 'w124-msg iw-msg';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red statements are marked wrongly. Which objective measures time, which measures data?';
      msg.className = 'w124-msg iw-msg bad';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w124-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rows.forEach(r => {
      r.sel = r.answer;
      r.btns[true].classList.toggle('w124-sel', r.answer === true);
      r.btns[false].classList.toggle('w124-sel', r.answer === false);
      r.el.classList.remove('w124-wrong');
      r.el.classList.add('w124-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w124-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w124-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rows.forEach(r => {
      r.sel = null;
      r.btns[true].classList.remove('w124-sel');
      r.btns[false].classList.remove('w124-sel');
    });
    clearMarks();
  });
})();
</script>
```
